name: Barrington Roberts Memorial Award
summary: A $4,000 award for 2026 graduates of TAFE NSW tourism, travel, events or hospitality qualifications.
who: Graduate of a TAFE NSW Tourism, Travel, Events or Hospitality qualification who completed studies in 2026.
how: Email the signed application form and supporting documents to scholarships@tafensw.edu.au.

source.label: TAFE NSW: Barrington Roberts Memorial Award

evidence.quote: Applications for the Barrington Roberts Memorial Award close 11:59 pm (AEDT) Sunday, 15 November 2026.
